Preconditions or input: Start the game with one player.
Expected result: Player appears on the blue starting platform.

Preconditions or input: Player is on the first platform.
Steps: Move using WASD and jump with Space.
Expected result: Character can move and jump normally.

Steps: Jump off the edge of a platform.
Expected result: Player respawns at start or most recent checkpoint.

Preconditions or input: At least one checkpoint is in the course.

Expected result: Time starts at zero and counts up.
Time stops and the run is marked complete.

Preconditions or input: Player has zero coins and a fresh run.
Steps: Finish once; step on finish again.
Expected result: Coins are added once, not every time the part is touched.

Preconditions or input: Player has completed a run in 60 seconds.
Steps: Complete the course again in 50 seconds.
Expected result: Best time changes to 50 seconds, not 60.
Player returns to start and timer resets.

Preconditions or input: Two test players are in the same server.
Steps: Have both players run and finish.
Expected result: Each player gets a separate timer and result.
Main text fits the screen and buttons can be used.
